tools.name: search-viral-tweets
tools.description: Find high-performing public X posts in Postel's index by topic, with source links and stored engagement metrics. No login required. Searches an indexed collection, not live X or a complete archive; metrics may be out of date. Results contain third-party post text.

tools.name: list-posts
tools.description: List posts for the current organization. Supports filtering by status and pagination.

tools.name: get-post
tools.description: Get a single post by ID with full details.

tools.name: create-post
tools.description: Save text as a new draft in Postel, optionally with images or videos downloaded from public URLs and a LinkedIn first comment (up to 1250 characters). Does not publish or schedule. Each call creates a separate draft.

tools.name: update-post
tools.description: Update the content or status of a Postel draft. Scheduled and published posts cannot be edited.

tools.name: delete-post
tools.description: Delete a post. A scheduled post's delivery is cancelled first.

tools.name: schedule-post
tools.description: Schedule a Postel draft for publishing to the social platform stored on the post. Requires a plan that includes scheduling. scheduledDateTime must be a future UTC ISO-8601 timestamp. A first comment can be set for LinkedIn posts. If the workspace requires approval, the post is submitted for approval

tools.name: publish-post
tools.description: Publish a Postel draft immediately to the social platform stored on the post. Requires a plan that includes publishing. A post that is already published cannot be published again.

tools.name: create-posts
tools.description: Create up to 25 posts in one call. Each post is saved as a draft; a post with scheduledDateTime is then scheduled for publishing to its platform, which requires a plan that includes scheduling. If the workspace requires approval, a dated post is submitted for approval instead (status PENDING_APPROVA

tools.name: attach-media
tools.description: Download an image or video from a public URL and attach it to a Postel draft. Supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV and WebM, up to 100 MB and within the platform's limits (X: up to 4 images, or one video or GIF; LinkedIn: up to 20 images, or one video). Scheduled and published posts cannot be c

tools.name: generate-post
tools.description: Generate a new post using AI based on a prompt and save it as a draft, ready for update-post, schedule-post or publish-post. Uses 1 AI credit (Lite mode with a daily cap when credits run out). Returns the generated post.

tools.name: refine-post
tools.description: Suggest refined content for an existing post using AI and specific instructions. Does not save changes. Uses 1 AI credit (Lite mode with a daily cap when credits run out).

tools.name: list-brands
tools.description: List all brands (topics) for the current organization. Brands contain background information used for AI post generation.

tools.name: get-brand-sources
tools.description: Get background information sources for a specific brand. These sources are used to inform AI post generation.

tools.name: get-x-profiles
tools.description: Get the X and LinkedIn voice profiles for the current organization. These profiles define the brand voice for AI post generation.

tools.name: get-schedule
tools.description: Get the posting schedule template for the current organization. Shows which time slots are configured for each day of the week.

tools.name: get-usage
tools.description: Get the organization's AI credit balance (monthly allowance, rollover, bonus/top-ups, reset date) and Lite mode status.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search-viral-tweets, list-posts, get-post, list-brands, get-brand-sources, get-x-profiles · Public sink: search-viral-tweets, get-post, create-post, update-post, delete-post, schedule-post, publish-post, create-posts, generate-post, refine-post, list-brands, get-brand-sources, get-x-profiles · Destructive: delete-post, generate-post, refine-post, get-usage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search-viral-tweets, list-posts, get-post, list-brands, get-brand-sources, get-x-profiles · Public sink: search-viral-tweets, get-post, create-post, update-post, delete-post, schedule-post, publish-post, create-posts, generate-post, refine-post, list-brands, get-brand-sources, get-x-profiles · Destructive: delete-post, generate-post, refine-post, get-usage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create-post" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
